   **   ~~~   ** ...use Output:Diagnostics,DisplayExtraWarnings; to show more details on individual Spaces.
messages.summary: GetSurfaceData: Entered Space Floor Area(s) differ more than 5% from calculated Space Floor Area(s).

exception_rule.pattern: GetSurfaceData:\ Entered\ Space\ Floor\ Area\(s\)\ differ\ more\ than\ 5%\ from\ calculated\ Space\ Floor\ Area\(s\)\.
exception_rule.rationale: The explicit Space area includes intermediate physical slabs represented by InternalMass. The compiler reconciles this area to the geometric base floors plus each physical slab once.
